top_n.description: Number of days to include in index.html.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated HTML/RSS files are written.

change_logs.description: List of ChangeLog files to process (supports wildcards via shell globbing).

css.description: Path to CSS file to embed/link in generated pages.

stop_date.description: Stop date (YYYY-MM-DD); entries on or after this date are excluded. Empty string means no limit.

encoding.description: Input encoding of ChangeLog files: 'eucjp', 'ascii', or 'utf8'. Note: 'utf8' requires passing the -8/--utf8 flag at runtime.

update_by_size.description: Overwrite output files only if they are larger than the new ones (--update-by-size).
